shorts.title: الفلوس ليه ليها قيمة أصلاً؟ 💵 #Shorts
shorts.description:
من سمكة قصاد رغيف، للدهب، للورق.. وسنة 1971 الدهب اتشال من ورا الورق. في زيمبابوي طبعوا ورقة بـ100 تريليون دولار وماكانتش تجيب تذكرة أتوبيس. يعني قيمة الفلوس جاية من حاجة واحدة: إن الكل مصدّق إن ليها قيمة.

en.title: Why Does Money Have Any Value? 💵 #Shorts
en.description:
From a fish for a loaf of bread, to gold, to paper... and in 1971 the gold was taken out from behind the paper. Zimbabwe printed a 100 trillion dollar note that couldn't buy a bus ticket. So money's value comes from one thing: everyone believes in it.

The full report: How Does Bitcoin Work? The Story From the Beginning | Crypto File 1/5

en.title: Your Money Isn't in a Vault. It's a Line in a Ledger 🏦 #Shorts
en.description:
A bank is not a vault full of money. A bank is a ledger. Your salary is a number, your rent is a number, a transfer is one number erased and another written. And whoever holds the ledger can charge you, delay you, freeze you... in Cyprus in 2013, big accounts lost almost half.

The full report: How Does Bitcoin Work? The Story From the Beginning | Crypto File 1/5
